name: @amodalai/example-invoice-approval
description: An Amodal example that reviews vendor invoices against purchase orders and a spend policy: a requester submits from a custom React UI, a durable tool matches the invoice in code and delegates the judgment to a reviewer subagent, an approver approves, returns, or rejects, four stores keep the invoices, purchase orders, reviews, and events, and a preToolUse guard hook enforces the hard rules platform-wide.

amodal.name: invoice-approval-example
amodal.description: Review vendor invoices against their purchase orders and a fictional spend policy. A requester submits an invoice, the invoice-reviewer subagent checks it and recommends approve, hold, escalate, or reject, and an approver decides or returns it for a fix. The agent assists; a human decides.
